Content availability

Release unconfirmed

Associated with Oona and packaged update 28. Public release is unconfirmed.

Stored map configuration for version 30, build 254. Packaged content does not establish live menu availability.

Values and comparisons match both the header and world records. Satisfaction, housing and equipment values are stored thresholds; their UI wording may differ. “Consume / recycle” is an internal condition whose wording depends on the target.

An absent field in an older map is not treated as disabled. Runtime defaults and migration remain unverified.

Counts below are serialized prefab entities. They do not establish harvest yields, stockpile units, or numbers of independent buildings; child entities and internal objects can be included.
